items.name: opnsense_url
items.description: Base URL of the OPNsense router's API. An IP, so it doesn't depend on the DNS it reads from.

items.name: opnsense_cert_sha256
items.description: Hex sha256 of the router's self-signed web certificate (DER), which is trusted instead of a CA.

items.name: router_name
items.description: Value of the router field on every query written, to tell routers apart.

items.name: poll_interval
items.description: How often to read the router's query log, as a Go duration. The router keeps only its newest 1000 queries (about 5 minutes), so keep this well under that.

items.name: request_timeout
items.description: Timeout for each request to the router or VictoriaLogs, as a Go duration.

items.name: victorialogs_urls
items.description: Every VictoriaLogs replica to write to. Each gets every query (the cluster's replicas are independent copies, written to in parallel).

items.name: buffer_limit
items.description: Most queries held in memory per VictoriaLogs replica while it can't be reached; beyond this the oldest are dropped.
